records.title: PCMind-2.1-Kaiyuan-2B Technical Report
records.reason: PCMind proposes data benchmarking, selective repetition and curriculum ordering for resource-constrained pretraining; evaluations compare model quality, but the mechanism is a training recipe and reports no inference-system optimization, leaving only an indirect OLMoE-family connection.

records.title: Us-vs-Them bias in Large Language Models
records.reason: The work studies social bias in language-model outputs, not model efficiency or inference systems.

records.title: Dynamic Load Balancing for Distributed Large Model Training: A Hybrid Framework of Gray Markov Chain and MDP
records.reason: Wiley publisher page exposed abstract and references, but its full-text host returned a technical-unavailability notice; no complete methods/evaluation text was accessible. The abstract describes distributed large-model training load balancing only, so it remains borderline for this inference-focused scope.

records.title: Bridging the Scale Gap: Balanced Tiny and General Object Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
records.reason: The method balances tiny/general object detectors for remote-sensing imagery; evaluations are object-detection datasets and metrics. Despite MoE-related citation context, the paper does not concern language models or their inference systems.

records.title: A temporal knowledge graph completion method based on feature interaction enhancement
records.reason: The method addresses temporal knowledge-graph completion, not LLM inference.
